name: Chris Deluzio
page_title: Chris Deluzio's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (PA) - District 17

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Chris believes in the simple idea that women should have the freedom to make their own healthcare and reproductive decisions: a basic human right."

"With the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade, we cannot allow right-wing extremists and the government to interfere with a woman’s decision regarding their health. That means we need federal and state action to codify the right to an abortion and a woman’s right to decide what’s best for them."
Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Chris is fighting to guarantee healthcare for every American and believes that healthcare is a human right. He supports efforts to lower the Medicare eligibility age; to expand Medicare to include dental, vision, and hearing services; to allow Medicare to negotiate better prescription drug prices; to expand Medicaid coverage to home care services for seniors and people with disabilities; and to close the Medicaid coverage gap. Chris will work hard to expand Medicare to achieve coverage for all Americans."

"Folks have earned their Medicare after years of sacrifice and service. Today, on the 58th anniversary of Medicare, I'm proud to support this program for our seniors and people with disabilities in Western PA and will always defend it from cuts."

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "Fiscal responsibility demands that the ultra-wealthy start paying their fair share in taxes."

"I don't think the richest billionaires in history should pay a lower tax rate than you. Pretty basic stuff, folks. And when I'm the next #PA17 Congressman, I'll fight to get these billionaires and huge corporations to pay their fair share in taxes."

"The #BuildBackBetter agenda will create good paying UNION jobs and build an economy that rewards work, not wealth. Added bonus: it’s the richest and most powerful who are going to pay for it—with tax cuts for more than 90% of households with kids."

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "To do this, we need to invest in the clean energy sources of the future, while protecting and creating union jobs in places like Allegheny and Beaver County that have kept the lights on in this country for over a century. positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "It’s exactly because of this background that Chris supports common sense gun reforms like background checks for every gun sale, getting high-capacity magazines and weapons of war off our streets and out of our schools, and red flag laws to keep guns out of the hands of people who are a danger to themselves or others."

Giffords "Deluzio strongly supports legislation to ban assault weapons and high-capacity magazines, as well as efforts to extend background checks to all gun sales and to make sure that dangerous weapons don’t fall into the hands of those seeking to do harm."
